title: Release to GitHub Script Settings
description: Configuration file for Release-ToGitHub.ps1 script (automated GitHub release creation)

projects.scheduleManagerCsprojEndsWith: Used to detect ScheduleManager csproj from csprojPath list
projects.uschedulerCsprojEndsWith: Used to detect UScheduler csproj from csprojPath list
projects.scheduleManagerAppSettingsFile: Config file name inside published output for ScheduleManager
projects.uschedulerAppSettingsFile: Config file name inside published output for UScheduler
projects.scheduleManagerServiceBinPath: Value written into USchedulerSettings.ServiceBinPath in ScheduleManager config
projects.uschedulerLogDir: Value written into Configuration.LogDir in UScheduler config
projects.scriptsRelativeToExe: Scripts base path relative to executable folder (used for appsettings script list)

shortcut.enabled: If true, creates a .lnk in staging root
shortcut.projectRole: Which project to point the shortcut to (ScheduleManager or UScheduler)
shortcut.fileName: Shortcut file name in staging root
